Histopathological examination of the cervical lymph node revealed tumor cells arranged in tubules with a dual layer (E006). Immunohistochemistry confirmed epithelial (CK7+) and myoepithelial (p63+) differentiation (E007), leading to a diagnosis of metastatic epithelial-myoepithelial carcinoma. Investigations to identify the primary site ruled out breast and lung lesions (E004). Radiological investigations for the low-backache revealed a lytic lesion in the left acetabulum (E001), consistent with metastatic disease.
